summary.intent: Execute Phase 72 (10 plans across 7 waves) for the cipher-box project using GSD's wave-based execute-phase workflow, after plan-checker verification of the phase 72 plans.
summary.outcome: Plan-checker passed with no blockers (only 4 cosmetic/doc-sync warnings); orchestrator resolved wave structure and chose sequential execution on the main tree instead of worktrees, then began Wave 0 by dispatching plan 72-01.

repo: cipher-box is a pnpm monorepo where fresh git worktrees lack node_modules — a known failure mode that breaks GSD's worktree-based parallel execution.
Phase 72 is ~90% serialized on client.ts: waves 1-4 are single-plan chains all touching that file, making worktree parallelism low-value for this phase.
Phase 72 wave structure: Wave 0 = 72-01/02/03 (parallel-safe, disjoint files); Waves 1-4 = 72-04→05→06→07 (serialized on client.ts); Wave 5 = 72-08 (client.ts) ∥ 72-09 (sdk-core); Wave 6 = 72-10.
sdk-e2e waves require the docker stack up with the API reachable on :3000.
workflow: GSD execute-phase's worktree auto-degrade check (#683) can report shouldDegrade=false (branch not diverged enough) even when worktrees are still the wrong choice for other reasons (e.g., pnpm node_modules) — the degrade flag isn't the sole signal to trust before picking parallel vs sequential execution.

When a phase is heavily serialized on one file, running sequentially on the main tree (skipping worktree isolation entirely) is a valid, more reliable strategy for unattended execution than forcing per-wave worktree parallelism.

In GSD sequential mode, each gsd-executor subagent (sonnet) independently handles its plan's tasks/TDD/commits/SUMMARY and updates STATE+ROADMAP itself — the orchestrator doesn't need to do this bookkeeping.

friction: Had to read the execute-phase.md workflow contract twice to fully resolve the executor prompt contract before dispatching.
Worktree isolation, the default per shouldDegrade=false, would have hit a pnpm node_modules failure mode if used naively — required manual override to sequential-on-main-tree.
open_items: Waves 1 through 6 (plans 72-02 through 72-10) still need to be executed after Wave 0 completes.

4 cosmetic plan-checker warnings deferred: 72-03 wave metadata over-serialization, missing (RESOLVED) markers on RESEARCH open-questions, artifacts location in must_haves.artifacts frontmatter vs a literal heading, and VALIDATION.md seed rows not backfilled.
A build+test gate is planned after waves complete, plus final phase verification — not yet run.
